name: Y2K
description: Chrome bubbles, hot pink, and a glossy late-90s gradient.
bestFor: Playful marketing that should feel like a millennium desktop toy.
promptFragment: Visual style: Y2K. Use glossy aqua-to-pink gradients, bubble radii, a white highlight edge, and a chunky purple offset under each panel. Type is a rounded sans. Avoid flat print, square corners, and a quiet single ink. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
